response.sql: WITH awards_by_hand AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_records FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')) SELECT batting_hand, award_records, award_records * 1.0 / SUM(award_records) OVER () AS share FROM awards_by_hand ORDER BY batting_hand

assumptions.assumption: Blank includes whitespace-only values; blank and NULL hands appear together as an empty string.
